fun_fact: This Independence Day, as we think about our dreams and aspirations for India, let's also remember that India is one of the countries most vulnerable to climate change — more than 80% of India's population lives in highly vulnerable districts. Let's think about how we build a future that is climate-resilient and makes sure India is a thriving place not just for a few but for all, including those living on the margins. Read more [here](https://thediplomat.com/2026/08/as-world-bank-retreats-from-climate-targets-indias-most-vulnerable-could-pay-the-price/).
author: Sailee
